<script>SELECT count(*) FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 <if test='state != null'>AND status=#{state}</if><if test='app != null'>AND application_id=CAST(#{app} AS bigint)</if></script>

INSERT INTO public.nocode_handling_request(id,application_id,application_name,application_version,object_id,object_name,entry_id,record_id,operation,name,request_key,request_digest,definition_checksum,definition_json,submission_id,process_definition_id,process_definition_key,status,creator,updater) VALUES(CAST(#{r.id} AS uuid),#{r.applicationId},#{r.applicationName},#{r.applicationVersion},#{r.objectId},#{r.objectName},#{r.entryId},#{r.recordId},#{r.operation},#{r.name},#{r.requestKey},#{r.requestDigest},#{r.definitionChecksum},CAST(#{r.definitionJson} AS jsonb),#{r.submissionId},#{r.processDefinitionId},#{r.processDefinitionKey},#{r.status},#{actor},#{actor})
SELECT *,id::text AS id,submission_id::text AS submission_id,definition_json::text AS definition_json FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7422,hashtext(#{key}))

<script>SELECT *,id::text AS id,submission_id::text AS submission_id,definition_json::text AS definition_json FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 <if test='state != null'>AND status=#{state}</if><if test='app != null'>AND application_id=CAST(#{app} AS bigint)</if> ORDER BY create_time DESC,nocode_handling_request.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}</script>
SELECT id::text FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE status='APPLY_PENDING' AND deleted=0 ORDER BY update_time LIMIT 20

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_handling_request WHERE object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND record_id=#{record} AND status IN ('PENDING','APPLY_PENDING','APPLY_FAILED') AND (CAST(#{except} AS text) IS NULL OR id::text!=#{except}) AND deleted=0)

UPDATE public.nocode_handling_request SET status=#{state},record_id=COALESCE(#{record},record_id),error=#{error},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND lock_version=#{revision} AND deleted=0

INSERT INTO public.nocode_record_history(object_id,record_id,application_id,operation,before_json,after_json,definition_json,creator,updater,operation_id,policy_version,source_json) VALUES(CAST(#{object} AS bigint),#{record},CAST(#{app} AS bigint),#{operation},CAST(#{before} AS jsonb),CAST(#{after} AS jsonb),CAST(#{definition} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor},CAST(#{operationId} AS uuid),#{policyVersion},CAST(#{source} AS jsonb))
SELECT covered_from::text FROM public.nocode_record_history_head WHERE object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND deleted=0

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE deleted=0 AND creator=#{actor} AND application_id=CAST(#{app} AS bigint) AND object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND record_id=#{record} AND operation='CREATE' AND source_json->>'kind'='TASK_ENTRY' AND source_json->>'entryId'=#{entry})

<script>SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'recordId',record_id,'operation',operation,'time',occurred_at,'actor',creator,'before',before_json,'after',after_json,'source',CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(source_json,'relatedEvents') THEN (source_json - 'relatedEvents') || jsonb_build_object('relatedUpdate',true) ELSE source_json END<if test='fields'>,'fields',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f->>'id','name',f->>'name')),'[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition_json->'fields') f),'detailFields',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',d->>'id','name',d->>'name','fields',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f->>'id','name',f->>'name')),'[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(d->'fields') f))),'[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition_json->'details') d)</if>)::text FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND deleted=0 AND occurred_at <= CAST(#{end} AS timestamptz) AND pg_visible_in_snapshot(written_txid,CAST(#{visibility} AS pg_snapshot)) AND occurred_at >= CAST(#{start} AS timestamptz) AND operation <> 'BASELINE' AND (occurred_at,id) > (CAST(#{cursorTime} AS timestamptz),#{cursorId})<if test='records != null'> AND record_id IN <foreach collection='records' item='record' open='(' separator=',' close=')'>#{record}</foreach></if> ORDER BY occurred_at,id LIMIT 1000</script>
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7418, hashtext(#{object}))

<script>SELECT jsonb_build_object('recordId',record_id,'row',after_json)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (record_id) record_id,after_json FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND deleted=0 AND occurred_at <= CAST(#{end} AS timestamptz) AND pg_visible_in_snapshot(written_txid,CAST(#{visibility} AS pg_snapshot)) AND record_id > #{cursor} ORDER BY record_id,occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1000) s</script>

<script>SELECT jsonb_build_object('recordId',record_id,'row',after_json,'fields',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f->>'id','name',f->>'name')),'[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(definition_json->'fields') f))::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (record_id) record_id,after_json,definition_json FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND deleted=0 AND occurred_at <= CAST(#{end} AS timestamptz) AND pg_visible_in_snapshot(written_txid,CAST(#{visibility} AS pg_snapshot))<if test='records != null'> AND record_id IN <foreach collection='records' item='record' open='(' separator=',' close=')'>#{record}</foreach></if> ORDER BY record_id,occurred_at DESC,id DESC) s</script>
INSERT INTO public.nocode_record_history_head(object_id,creator,updater) VALUES(CAST(#{object} AS bigint),#{actor},#{actor})

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'recordId',record_id,'time',occurred_at,'operation',operation,'before',before_json,'after',after_json,'related',jsonb_exists(source_json,'relatedEvents'))::text FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE deleted=0 AND creator=#{actor} AND application_id=CAST(#{app} AS bigint) AND object_id=CAST(#{object} AS bigint) AND source_json->>'kind'='TASK_ENTRY' AND source_json->>'entryId'=#{entry} AND id < #{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT coalesce(max(id),0) FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE written_txid=pg_current_xact_id() AND deleted=0

SELECT jsonb_build_object('eventId',id::text,'objectId',object_id::text,'recordId',record_id,'operationId',operation_id::text)::text FROM public.nocode_record_history WHERE written_txid=pg_current_xact_id() AND deleted=0 AND id>#{checkpoint} AND application_id=CAST(#{app} AS bigint) AND creator=#{actor} AND operation<>'BASELINE' ORDER BY id
SELECT jsonb_build_object('end',clock_timestamp(),'visibility',pg_current_snapshot()::text)::text

com.richuang.os.nocode.work.dal.mapper.d.sqlTemplate:
<script>
SELECT id, create_time AS created_at FROM public.nocode_work_draft
WHERE creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND source_type=#{source}
  AND resource_json->>'applicationId'=#{query.applicationId} AND state=#{query.state}
<if test="query.before != null">
  AND (create_time,id) < (CAST(#{query.before.createdAt} AS timestamp),#{query.before.id})
</if>
ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{count}
</script>

INSERT INTO public.nocode_work_draft(id,source_type,source_id,state,resource_json,object_id,record_id,base_record_revision,values_json,details_json,related_json,creator,updater) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.sourceType},#{row.sourceId},#{row.state},CAST(#{row.resourceJson} AS jsonb),#{row.objectId},#{row.recordId},#{row.baseRecordRevision},CAST(#{row.valuesJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{row.detailsJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{row.relatedJson} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor})
SELECT id FROM public.nocode_work_draft WHERE creator=#{actor} AND source_type=#{source} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND state=#{state} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY update_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_work_draft WHERE id=#{id} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE

UPDATE public.nocode_work_draft SET values_json=CAST(#{row.valuesJson} AS jsonb),details_json=CAST(#{row.detailsJson} AS jsonb),related_json=CAST(#{row.relatedJson} AS jsonb),base_record_revision=#{row.baseRecordRevision},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{row.id} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND state=#{state} AND lock_version=#{expected}

<script>
SELECT id, source_id, create_time AS created_at FROM public.nocode_work_draft
WHERE creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND source_type=#{source} AND state=#{query.state}
<if test="query.before != null">
  AND (create_time,id) < (CAST(#{query.before.createdAt} AS timestamp),#{query.before.id})
</if>
ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{count}
</script>

UPDATE public.nocode_work_draft SET state=#{next},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND state=#{current} AND lock_version=#{expected}
